faqs.question: What are your support hours?
faqs.answer: Our support team is available 9am-6pm ET, Monday through Friday.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password, and follow the emailed link.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer full refunds within 30 days of purchase. Contact support@example.com to start a request.

faqs.question: How do I contact a human support agent?
faqs.answer: Email support@example.com or use the live chat widget in the bottom-right corner of the dashboard.
